title: 第23章 齐格飞的异常第24章 勇者的同伴
slug: 异世界开局俘虏女骑士
lines: “冷读、演技、速写、推理、算数、心理学、厚黑学、厨艺、猎术…………太多了，这怎么可能？“
正常人的专精只有三到四个，杨静有四个专精已经是天赋异禀了，而且忍术明显是加进来凑数的。
但齐格飞这挤满了半张纸涉猎了各种领域的专精几乎全都是40%朝上的熟练度。
齐格飞没意识到他自己的异常，但杨静明白。
她在两年前就因为动物会话这项特殊的专精，被夏侬选中成为漫游者。
两年来，无论是在地球还是在她漫游过的各个世界，她从来没就没见过有什么生物的专精能超过五个以上的。
所谓的专精绝对不是指你会一点就算专精了。
比如你会开车，这是不能算专精的。
你得会弹射起步、漂移、快速过弯等炫酷车技才能算专精，而且还只是入门的熟练度。如果你能在秋名山跑赢那辆AE86，那恭喜你，这至少是大师级的车技。
杨静僵硬地抬起头，任谁都能看出她此刻内心的震动。
（这真的还是人吗？）
一个人到底要经历什么才能掌握这么多生存技巧。
“嗯？你怎么了？”
齐格飞有些讶异地问道。难道他的数据真的惨淡到如此不堪入目？
“啊，不，没什么……”
（夏侬没有告诉他专精的作用吗？难道，连夏侬也不明白他这到是什么情况？）
反复思索了一阵，杨静下定了决心。
齐格飞虽然有很多专精，但几乎都不适合战斗，这次他又选择了极其困难的路线完成任务，如果放任不管他肯定会死在半途中。
杨静的朋友不多，她很不愿意看到这位拥有共同境遇的友人死在这个陌生的异世界，所以她郑重开口道：
“我看了你的状态栏，在没有职阶的情况下c级的综合评价已经很厉害了。”
“职阶？”
齐格飞这才意识到他的职阶一直都是村民，在游戏里就是还没有转职的最低级的兵种。
“在这个世界上每个人的战力都能从他的职阶来判断。“
”以骑士这个职业来打比方，见习骑士的综合评价一般是d，正式骑士是c，大骑士是b，黄金骑士是A，神圣骑士是S，史诗骑士是SS。”
“我就是盗贼职业的刺客大师，相当于黄金骑士这个等级。我们漫游者可以同时持有多个职阶，不过每次只能装备一个。装备哪一个职阶，就能获得对应的能力提升。如果是战士就比较偏向筋力，刺客就比较偏向敏捷，骑士属于全能型，魔法师会增加魔力和智力。“
杨静滔滔不绝地为齐格飞灌输着这个世界的提升实力的方法，齐格飞也利用他强大的记忆力记录着这些重要的知识。
“一般情况下人类所能达到极限就是S级。在那之上就是传奇的领域，特殊的职介，其中最有代表性的就是……
“勇者和魔王。”齐格飞心念一动，不由自主地抢答道。
“对，这两个职阶是破格的SSS级，你冒充的时候要小心一点，以你的实力一不小心就会穿帮的。“
齐格飞眼角抽搐，看来这个女人压根没打算忘记刚才的事。
“获得职阶的方法很简单，就是学习这个职阶的武技或者魔法。“
“以我的职阶为例子，首先要学习【气息隐秘】这个武技，学会之后就能成为正式盗贼，获得职阶。”
“想要继续提升职阶就去学习刺客和刺客大师的武技，魔法师也是以类似的方式晋升的。”
说来简单，其实光是学习【气息隐秘】对于平民百姓就不太可能。
杨静这具叫做“星梅”的身体出身优渥，能接触到王都里的刺客兄弟会，可以直接去兄弟会的刺客培训班进行系统性的教育。
老百姓就没这个门路，只能靠天赋自己领悟了。比如罗兰这个挂逼，七岁的时候就自己把【骑士冲锋】领悟了一半，成为了半个正式骑士。
“谢谢，真的非常受用。“齐格飞再一次郑重地道谢，杨静不是一个爱说话的人，今天她会说这么多肯定是为了让自己少走弯路。
这种事情是不可能去问克琳希德他们的。毕竟，堂堂当代梅兰，勇者候补，怎么会连这种事情都不知道？
然而杨静却没有回应齐格飞道谢，她面露忧愁，有点迟疑的继续说道：
“还有一件事……”
content_en:
"Cold reading, acting, sketching, reasoning, arithmetic, psychology, black science, cooking, hunting... there are too many, how is this possible?"
Normal people only have three to four specializations. Yang Jing has four specializations and is already extremely talented. Ninjutsu is obviously added to make up the number.
But Siegfried's expertise, which is filled with half a piece of paper and covers various fields, almost all has a proficiency level of 40% upwards.
Siegfried didn't realize his own abnormality, but Yang Jing understood.
She was selected by Shannon to become the Rover two years ago because of her special expertise in animal conversation.
In the past two years, whether on Earth or in the worlds she has roamed, she has never seen any creature with more than five specializations.
The so-called expertise definitely does not mean that you are expert if you know a little bit.
For example, if you can drive a car, this cannot be considered a specialization.
You have to be able to perform cool driving skills such as catapult start, drifting, and fast cornering to be considered a proficient person, and this is only an entry-level proficiency. If you can outrun that AE86 in Akinayama, then congratulations, this is at least a master-level driving skill.
Yang Jing raised her head stiffly, and anyone could see the shock in her heart at this moment.
(Is this really a human being?)
What does a person have to go through to master so many survival skills?
"Huh? What's wrong with you?"
Siegfried asked in surprise. Are his statistics really so dismal that they are so unsightly?
"Ah, no, it's nothing..."
(Didn’t Shannon tell him the role of specialization? Could it be that even Shannon didn’t understand what was going on with him?)
After thinking about it for a while, Yang Jing made up her mind.
Although Siegfried has many specializations, they are almost never suitable for combat. This time he chose an extremely difficult route to complete the mission. If left unchecked, he would definitely die on the way.
Yang Jing didn't have many friends. She didn't want to see this friend who shared the same situation die in this strange world, so she solemnly said:
"I looked at your status bar, and the overall evaluation of C-level is already very impressive without a job rank."
"Class?"
Only then did Siegfried realize that his class had always been a villager. In the game, he was the lowest class of soldiers who had not yet changed classes.
"Everyone's combat prowess in this world can be judged by his rank."
"Using the profession of knight as an example, the overall evaluation of a trainee knight is generally D, a formal knight is C, a grand knight is B, a golden knight is A, a holy knight is S, and an epic knight is SS."
"I am the Assassin Master of the Thief profession, which is equivalent to the level of the Golden Knight. We wanderers can hold multiple classes at the same time, but we can only equip one at a time. Whichever class you equip will get the corresponding ability improvement. If you are a warrior, you will be more focused on physical strength, an assassin will be more focused on agility, a knight is an all-rounder, and a magician will increase your magic power and intelligence."
Yang Jing kept instilling in Siegfried the methods of improving strength in this world, and Siegfried also used his powerful memory to record these important knowledge.
"Generally, the limit that humans can reach is S-level. Above that is the legendary field, special job agencies, the most representative of which is...
“The brave man and the devil. " Siegfried had a thought in his mind and answered involuntarily.
"Yes, these two classes are special SSS classes. You have to be careful when pretending to be someone else. With your strength, you can get into trouble if you are not careful. "
The corners of Siegfried's eyes twitched. It seemed that this woman had no intention of forgetting what happened just now.
“The way to obtain a class is very simple, which is to learn the martial arts or magic of this class. "
"Take my class as an example. You must first learn the martial skill [Aura Concealment]. After learning it, you can become an official thief and obtain a class. "
"If you want to continue to advance in the ranks, you should learn the martial arts of assassins and master assassins. Magicians are promoted in a similar way. "
It sounds simple, but in fact, just learning [the secret of breath] is unlikely for ordinary people.
Yang Jing's body called "Xingmei" came from a privileged background and had access to the Assassin Brotherhood in the capital. She could directly go to the Brotherhood's assassin training class for systematic education.
Ordinary people don't have this way, they can only rely on their talent to realize it. For example, Roland, this idiot, half-understood [Knight's Charge] when he was seven years old, and became a half-official knight.
"Thank you, it's really helpful. "Siegfried solemnly thanked her again. Yang Jing is not a talkative person. She must have said so much today to avoid taking detours.
It was impossible to ask Clinhide and the others about this kind of thing. After all, how could the dignified contemporary Mei Lan, a brave candidate, not even know about such a thing?
However, Yang Jing did not respond to Siegfried's thanks. She looked sad and continued with a little hesitation:
"One more thing..."
